§6Space Station Deployment§f is the launch milestone that turns a built station into an orbital outpost. Compile a station via the Space Station Assembler, retrieve the Container and ID Chip, load the Container into a rocket's Satellite Bay, and launch.

When the rocket reaches orbit, the container auto-deploys and the station blocks spawn in space. The Space Station ID Chip is your return key, insert it into a Guidance Computer on any future rocket to set the station as destination.

§cWARNING:§f Orbiting stations are in vacuum. Never travel without a fully charged Space Suit with Airtight Seal or you will suffocate instantly.

§ePS:§f This is the most important mid-game milestone. Every late-game AR content, warping, gas giant mining, satellite missions, requires an orbital station.
